messages:
Anya: Quick PR heads-up — opened docs PR #482 for the Console Observability section. It's a small cleanup: UX copy tweaks for the dashboard widgets, plus updated sample payloads for metrics v2. Can someone do a quick pass?
Mike: On it. Which files? link?
Anya: docs/console/observability/widgets.md and docs/console/observability/migration-metrics-v2.md. PR link: https://git.internal/redwood-inference/pulls/482
DocsBot: PR #482 created by Anya — reviewers requested: @Mike @Sam. CI: docs-build passed.
Sam: Skimming now. Initial note: the sample widget JSON uses "metric_name" in one example and "metric" in another — we should pick one and add a short note for migration.
Anya: Good catch. The runtime now prefers "metric" (back-compat shim exists but we want canonical examples). I'll update the examples to use "metric" and add a migration bullet.
Kevin: Also check the cost/latency breakdown snippet — the SDK sample in python uses the old client.method signature. We recently changed to client.request_metrics(...).
Julia: I can update the python snippet and add a tiny TS example for the Console embed.
Mike: One more UX copy thing: widget title placeholder currently says "My Widget" — industry practice is to show a descriptive example like "Tail Latency (p95)" for clarity.
Anya: Agreed — swapping placeholder text. Also adding a small note about recommended percentiles and typical retention.
Sam: For tracing hooks, the link in the tracing section points to the old internal tracing doc. Need to update to /docs/integrations/tracing-hooks.md — there are new examples for distributed traces and sampling config.
Anya: I'll replace the link and add a cross-ref to the dashboard traces panel.
DocsBot: Reminder: documentation style checklist not met — missing changelog entry for metrics v2 in docs/CHANGELOG.md.
Anya: Adding changelog entry now.
Kevin: For the sample JSON, please include abbreviated KV-cache example to show prefix caching impact on cost — just a 3-line snippet. Ops wants the cost delta callout.
Julia: Drafted python snippet: ```python
from redwood import ConsoleClient
client = ConsoleClient(api_key=...)
resp = client.request_metrics(metric="inference.latency.p95", range="1h")
print(resp)
```
Mike: Looks good. Two tiny nitpicks: 1) use `api_key="REDACTED"` in examples instead of ...; 2) add a one-line comment about needing `metrics.v2` feature flag for some accounts.
Anya: Will do both.
Sam: Can someone run link-checker after these changes? I can queue a docs-build but would like a run before merging.
Mike: I'll trigger link-checker after CI passes.
Anya: Thanks all — aiming to merge by EOD. If anyone has a quick wording suggestion for the migration note: current draft: "Rename metric_name -> metric. The server accepts both for now; prefer `metric` for new configs." Thoughts?
Kevin: Shorten to: "Use `metric` (preferred). `metric_name` is supported temporarily for backwards compatibility."
Julia: +1
Sam: +1
Anya: Updated in PR. Ping me if you see anything else. :thumbsup:
